title: Refine the Windows cleanup admission-cut check without adding retries
outcome: Windows cleanup distinguishes fully captured early process admissions from incomplete cuts while preserving fail-closed release proof and the existing budget.
acceptance: Assess a retry-free admission-count comparison around member capture and document its exact guarantee.

If refined, prove that admissions already included in the captured cut do not cause false unresolved and that uncaptured new members cannot produce reaped, with deterministic controls and unchanged budget.
